retrospective.rootCause: AccountRecoveryTests composes InstallationRecoveryTests by invoking setUp and reusing its Manager. The preceding repair added an instance release_accounts=False substitute to that ordinary-UID fixture. The root consumer restored verify_release but not release_accounts, misclassifying a real account-v1 candidate as legacy. Production Manager remained unchanged.
retrospective.whyMissed: The prior author and independent review validated changed fixture definitions and their selected root neighbors but missed the ordinary fixture composition in root account recovery. The selector paired installation recovery only with root release reuse, omitting this actual consumer. The prior narrow passes did not cover account recovery.
retrospective.classification: Fixture regression plus incomplete test impact mapping; not a demonstrated production authentication bypass.
retrospective.reproducibleFixtureContract: Root AccountRecoveryTests composes the ordinary setup and reuses its Manager. Root tests must restore real verify_release and release_accounts on that exact instance; ordinary instances retain their isolated replacement. Account-v1 metadata must remain distinguishable from legacy metadata before rollback selection.
prevention: Group ordinary installation recovery, root account recovery and root release reuse bidirectionally. Regression asserts exact group membership for every changed member and requires review if any companion is missing.

Record the CI2 failure and a specific composition/setup/method-rebinding/cleanup inspection rule in maintainer preflight lessons. No workflow/full-suite rule or application capability check was weakened.

consumerReview.composedConsumer: tests/deploy/root/test_account_recovery.py::AccountRecoveryTests calls InstallationRecoveryTests.setUp; no inheritance is involved.
consumerReview.otherConsumers: Repository Python reference search found no other consumer of InstallationRecoveryTests and no external consumer of TransactionTests. Other explicit setup reuse is candidate-archive/archive fixture and proxy-transaction/execution fixture, without these release_accounts replacements.
consumerReview.scope: Both substitutes are assigned to newly constructed Manager instances, not the Manager class. Root restoration is bound to its own instance. The composed fixture doCleanups is registered on the outer test, retaining temporary-directory cleanup; ordinary instances keep the intended token-only isolation.
